## Problem and behavior

Describe the reproducible trigger, old behavior, new behavior and files changed. Human and Agent contributions follow the same evidence requirements.

## Validation

- Native reproducer / regression and actual exit codes:
- Fault withdrawal (R2), when behavior requires it:
- Full Release / type-load / unfiltered kernel gate receipt:
- Source, game, dependency and double-DLL identity:
- Performance budget and measured cost:

For strategy changes, include development versus preregistered holdout seeds, all attempts (including hangs/exceptions), full-ascent outcomes and uncertainty. Mixed tables are evaluated separately. Tooling CI does not establish game correctness or win rate.

## Boundaries

Document unsupported cases or missing evidence. Check submitted logs/fixtures for account IDs, local credentials and private histories; keep upstream notices intact. See CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENT.md.
